subject: Mythology
title: The Pyramids: Stairways to Heaven
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Pyramids: Stairways to Heaven.

hook.text: The pyramids were not just tombs. They were machines designed to launch the pharaoh's soul into the stars.

buildup.text: The shape mimicked the rays of the sun. Internal passages aligned with specific stars for the soul's journey.

discovery.text: The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest building in the world for nearly four thousand years.

twist.text: It took twenty years and thousands of skilled workers — not slaves — who were fed, housed, and honored.

climax.text: The pyramids remain the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World, outlasting everything built beside them.

punchline.text: They built a staircase to heaven that still stands after 4,500 years.

quiz.question: What mythological purpose did the pyramids serve?
options: They were temples where priests performed daily rituals
They were designed to launch the pharaoh's soul to the stars
They stored the wealth the pharaoh needed in the afterlife
